criteria.criterion: The Jira DC exact-patchset parity workflow checks out the exact requested Gerrit patchset SHA before any live DC operation runs; checked by pytest tests/unit/test_jira_dc_exact_patchset_workflow.py, actionlint, Gerrit Verified+1, and the HEAD == GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION guard embedded in the workflow.

If the requested patchset refspec cannot be fetched from either the GitHub mirror or Gerrit fallback, the workflow fails with a clear fetch/input error rather than landing on a different commit; checked by a focused temporary-git test in tests/unit/test_jira_dc_exact_patchset_workflow.py.

citation.description: Ticket comment attests Gerrit change 2508 merged at a85cb4781845ccf0d8c0375adce9a01391ba4bc8 with LLM-Review+1, Verified+1, run 33592409853. Workflow writes verified_sha to GITHUB_ENV and GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY. Criterion explicitly defers live DC dispatch to future; in-session completion is AC1/AC2 + Gerrit Verified+1.

criteria.criterion: The workflow records enough evidence for a future CI dispatch to prove the live Data Center lane ran from HEAD == expected_sha; in-session completion rests on AC1/AC2 plus Gerrit review/Verified results, and the future live dispatch evidence is a GitHub Actions run id whose summary lists the verified SHA.
Bug '[ci] Jira DC exact-patchset parity aborts after checking out the wrong patchset SHA' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds.
